# Number input (`number-input`)

Number entry with − / + buttons, units and drag-to-scrub.

Group: Text inputs. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/text-inputs';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createNumberInput` (types in `dist/web/text-inputs/numberInput.d.ts`): `.mh-input.mh-number-input`: a value with − and + buttons either side, an optional prefix and unit, inside a `.mh-field`. The value is a text input with `role="spinbutton"` (arrow keys step, Page Up/Down take large steps, typed text is committed on Enter or blur and Escape reverts it); the buttons repeat while held and stay out of the Tab order, as in the ARIA spinbutton pattern. Dragging the unit sideways scrubs the value.

```ts
export function createNumberInput(options: NumberInputOptions): NumberInputHandle;

export interface NumberInputOptions {
  /** Visible label. Without one, pass `ariaLabel`; the input then renders the box alone. */
  label?: string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  value?: number;
  min?: number;
  max?: number;
  /** Step of the buttons, the arrow keys and scrubbing (default 1). Typed values snap to it. */
  step?: number;
  /** Step of Page Up / Page Down and of Shift while scrubbing (default ten steps). */
  largeStep?: number;
  /** Decimal places shown; default: those of `step`. */
  precision?: number;
  /** The unit after the value ("°C", "%", "min"). */
  unit?: string;
  /** Text before the value, e.g. a currency sign. */
  prefix?: string;
  /** The spoken value; default the value and unit ("21.5 °C"). */
  valueText?: (value: number) => string;
  /** Dragging the unit (or a grip when there is no unit) sideways changes the value (default true). */
  scrub?: boolean;
  /** Pixels of drag per step (default 8). */
  scrubDistance?: number;
  name?: string;
  helper?: string;
  error?: string;
  required?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  size?: InputSize;
  labelStyle?: 'label' | 'eyebrow';
  decreaseLabel?: string;
  increaseLabel?: string;
  /** Called with each new value: a step, a scrub, or typed text once it is committed (Enter or leaving the field). */
  onChange?: (value: number) => void;
}

export interface NumberInputHandle {
  /** The field (or the bare box without a label). */
  el: HTMLElement;
  /** The text input (`role="spinbutton"`). */
  input: HTMLInputElement;
  field: FieldHandle | null;
  getValue(): number;
  setValue(value: number): void;
  setError(text: string | undefined): void;
  setHelper(text: string | undefined): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}

export interface FieldHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  label: HTMLLabelElement | HTMLSpanElement;
  /** The described element (input, select, textarea or the control). */
  target: HTMLElement;
  setHelper(text: string | undefined): void;
  setError(text: string | undefined): void;
  setSuccess(text: string | undefined): void;
  /** Updates the counter: `3 / 40` with a max, `3` without. */
  setCount(count: number, max?: number): void;
  /** Dims the label and messages (the control disables itself). */
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createNumberInput } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const target = createNumberInput({
  label: 'Target temperature',
  value: 21.5,
  min: 7,
  max: 30,
  step: 0.5,
  unit: '°C',
  helper: 'Between 7 and 30 °C.',
  onChange: (value) => target.setHelper(`Heating to ${value} °C.`),
});

document.body.append(target.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { NumberInput } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function NumberInputExample() {
  const [target, setTarget] = useState(21.5);
  return (
    <NumberInput
      label="Target temperature"
      value={target}
      min={7}
      max={30}
      step={0.5}
      unit="°C"
      helper={`Heating to ${target} °C.`}
      onChange={setTarget}
    />
  );
}
```
